title: Plans to Jumpstart Aviation Sector, Ensure Success of Singapore AirShow 2022 and Extend Vaccinated Travel Lanes in Face of Rise in COVID-19 Omicron Cases
what_it_is: Plans to Jumpstart Aviation Sector, Ensure Success of Singapore AirShow 2022 and Extend Vaccinated Travel Lanes in Face of Rise in COVID-19 Omicron Cases

sections.label: VTL border measures and outlook
sections.summary: Questions asked the Minister for Transport about indicators for changing border measures, VTL capacity, PCR tests, ticket sales freeze and the 2022 outlook for air and maritime hubs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport in relation to the COVID-19 Omicron variant virus, what key global and domestic indicators are being monitored to assess the need to change our border measures and adjustments to both the Vaccinated Travel Lanes, their land capacity, flight sales caps and allocated quotas; and (b) what is the 2022 outlook for our regional air and maritime hubs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport whether additional polymerase chain reaction (PCR) tests will be required several days after arrival into Singapore for Vaccinated Travel Lane (VTL) travellers, especially for those arriving from countries with high incidence of COVID-19 Omicron cases, in case the first PCR test upon arrival into Singapore does not pick up the infection.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport whether the freeze on new bus and flight ticket sales for the Vaccinated Travel Lane (VTL) is necessary as Singapore moves towards treating the COVID-19 disease as endemic.

sections.label: Limiting VTL flights to airlines
sections.summary: Questions asked the Minister for Transport why VTL flights are limited to specific airlines and whether more airlines and flights will be considered.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) what are the reasons for limiting Vaccinated Travel Lane (VTL) flights to only specific airlines; and (b) whether the Ministry will consider including more airlines, especially low-cost carriers, as well as more flights during festive periods like Chinese New Year and Hari Raya, to ensure that lower-cost options are available to those who need to travel.

sections.label: Omicron restrictions on African countries
sections.summary: Singapore restricted entry and transit of non-residents from seven Sub-saharan African countries from 28 November and three more from 5 December.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: As a precautionary move, based on reports of the spread of Omicron in Sub-saharan Africa, we restricted the entry and transit of non-residents from Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho, Mozambique, Namibia, South Africa and Zimbabwe from 28 November; and from Ghana, Malawi and Nigeria from 5 December.

sections.label: VTL ticket sales freeze and limit
sections.summary: Singapore froze sale of new VTL flight and bus tickets from 23 December 2021 to 20 January 2022 and limited daily VTL travellers by 50% from 21 January.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: On 22 December, given the rapid and global spread of the Omicron variant, we froze the sale of new VTL flight and bus tickets for entry into Singapore from 23 December 2021 to 20 January 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: We also imposed a 50% limit on the daily number of VTL travellers from 21 January this year.

sections.label: Key source countries
sections.summary: The key sources were the United States at 16%, United Kingdom at 16% and India at 11%.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The key sources were the United States at 16%, United Kingdom at 16% and India at 11%.

sections.label: HEPA purifiers at airport terminals
sections.summary: 350 High Efficiency Particulate Absorbing portable air purifiers have been installed throughout airport terminals at staff canteens, rest areas and health screening stations.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Since then, 350 High Efficiency Particulate Absorbing (HEPA) portable air purifiers have been installed throughout the airport terminals at locations, such as staff canteens, rest areas and health screening stations.

sections.label: Maritime hub COVID-19 performance
sections.summary: The maritime hub weathered COVID-19 relatively well, with container throughput likely reaching an all-time high in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Our maritime hub has weathered the COVID-19 crisis relatively well, with container throughput at our port likely to reach an all-time high in 2021.

sections.label: Changi passenger traffic recovery
sections.summary: Changi passenger traffic rose to about 15% of pre-COVID-19 levels by December 2021, aided by VTL schemes.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Compared to 3% at the start of 2021, passenger traffic at Changi increased to about 15% of pre-COVID-19 levels by the end of December 2021, largely aided by our VTL schemes.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: A study by the International Air Transport Association (IATA) and Oxford Economics has projected international passenger volume at the end of 2022 to recover to about 55% of 2019 levels, which is up from about 20% at the end of last year.

sections.label: Kualanamu Airport Indonesia expansion
sections.summary: Indonesia's Deputy Minister said Kualanamu can reduce Changi and KLIA dominance, with GMR committing 56 trillion rupiahs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: First, in relation to a Nikkei article on 4 December, I quote Indonesia's Deputy Minister of State-owned Enterprises, Mr Kartika Wirjoatmodjo, mentioning in parliament about Kualanamu Airport, which they are actually looking to operate in Indonesia's North Sumatra region.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: He said, "Kualanamu can be a base to reduce dominance of Changi and KLIA" and that GMR Airports group has committed 56 trillion rupiahs or $3.8 billion to support the expansion.

sections.label: Rebuilding international aviation hub status
sections.summary: Singapore is committed to rebuilding its aviation hub status, with VTLs raising volumes to about 15% of pre-COVID-19 levels.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But we are committed, as I have said earlier, to reclaiming and rebuilding our status as an international aviation hub.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: And our VTLs have helped us to raise volumes to about 15% or so of pre-COVID-19 levels by the end of last year and, based on both global projections and our own anticipation, we should be able to do better this year.

sections.label: Passenger volume growth protocols
sections.summary: Current protocols limit passenger volume growth, so authorities and aviation partners will assess flexibility and rate-limiting steps.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The Member's second point was on passenger volumes and, if we want to increase passenger volumes, what would it entail.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: I think it is fair to say that the current protocols, whilst necessary, do impose a limit on how much we can grow within the current set of formulations.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: So, we will have to work with our health authorities and the aviation partners to ascertain how much flexibility we have, going forward, and what are the possible rate-limiting steps or aspects that we need to reconfigure so that we can go for the next bound of growth in terms of passenger volumes in Changi.

sections.label: Protecting frontline airport workers
sections.summary: The highest priority is protecting the health and welfare of frontline airport workers, without whom the airport cannot function.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Our highest priority is protecting the health and welfare of our frontline airport workers because, without them, the airport will not be able to function.

sections.label: N95 masks worn
sections.summary: In almost all settings, workers now wear N95 masks in addition to the usual garb.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: In almost all the settings, they now wear N95 masks, for example, apart from the usual garb.

sections.label: SMMs top priority
sections.summary: SMMs are the top priority, protocols like facial IDs are in place, and more will be done if evidence shows a need.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: So, it is a constant recalibration, taking into account the risks, whilst we also focus on the welfare of the workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: So, the short answer to the Member's question is, of course, SMMs are our top priority and, when it comes to aspects like facial IDs and so on, all the necessary protocols are put in place and, if there is evidence that we need to do more, we will do more.
